armySpecialRules.name: Animosity
armySpecialRules.description:
Units with this special rule must test for Animosity in
the Charge sub-phase after all normal charges have
been declared during each of your turns, unless any of
the following applies:
• The unit has fewer than 5 models.
• The unit has declared a charge this turn.
• The unit is engaged in close combat.
• The unit is garrisoning a building.
• The unit is fleeing or currently off the battlefield.
Roll a D6 for each eligible unit. If the dice roll is a 2 or
more, the unit behaves normally this turn. If the roll is
a 1, however, the unit has failed its Animosity test and
must roll on the Animosity table below:
D6 Result
1 Get 'Em: For every complete rank the unit
has, it suffers D3 hits at the Strength
characteristic of the majority of the models in
the unit. The unit may not voluntarily move
or shoot this turn. Wounds caused by the Get
'Em result never cause Panic tests.
2-4 Squabble: If it is possible to do so, the unit
must declare a charge against the closest
viable enemy unit. If the unit is unable to
declare a charge, the unit may not move in
the Movement phase or shoot this turn.
5-6 We'll Show 'Em: Pivot the unit on the spot
to face the nearest visible enemy unit, and
then make a full normal move in a straight
line towards it. If there is no visible enemy,
the unit must move straight ahead instead. If
it is impossible for the unit to pivot to face
the closest enemy, it will pivot towards it as
far as it can, and will then move as far
forward as it can while still keeping the
enemy within its forward arc. After the move
is complete the unit must declare a charge
against the closest visible enemy unit, if it is
possible to do so. If the unit cannot declare a
charge then it may carry on with the rest of
its turn normally, as if it had not yet moved
this turn.

armySpecialRules.name: Armed To Da Teef
armySpecialRules.description:
If a model with this special rule has more than one
weapon and/or a shield, they may choose which
weapon combination they want to use at the start of
each round of close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: Greenskin Races
armySpecialRules.description:
Characters may only join units of the same race or sub-
species (such as Common Orc, Savage Orc, Black Orc,
Common Goblin, Forest Goblin, Night Goblin or
Snotling). Black Orc characters may still join units of
Common Orcs, however.

armySpecialRules.name: Fear Elves
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule treat all Elves as causing
Fear against them.

armySpecialRules.name: Magic Mushrooms
armySpecialRules.description:
A Wizard with this special rule may eat a Magic
Mushroom once per Magic phase, before casting a
spell. This adds another D6 to the casting result. This
dice does not count as a power dice, and cannot
contribute to Ultimate Power. However, if you roll a 1
on this dice you must roll a further D6. On a roll of 4+
nothing else happens, but on a roll of 1-3 the Wizard
suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves, and the
spell automatically fails.

armySpecialRules.name: Quell Animosity
armySpecialRules.description:
If a model with this special rule is in a unit that fails an
Animosity test, they immediately inflict D6 hits at their
base Strength on their unit, distributed as shooting
attacks. After removing casualties, the unit is treated as
if the Animosity test was passed. These hits cannot be
allocated to characters with this special rule, and do not
cause a Panic test.

armySpecialRules.name: Size Matters
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule treat Goblins and
Snotlings of all types as Expendable.

armySpecialRules.name: Spider Venom
armySpecialRules.description:
A Wizard with this special rule may re-roll one dice per
Magic phase when casting spells. However, any time
they Miscast, they will also count as having failed a
Stupidity test (if they survive).

armySpecialRules.name: Tusker Charge
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this special rule have the Mighty Blow (1)
special rule in any turn that they charge.

armySpecialRules.name: Army Special Rules
armySpecialRules.description:
WAAAGH!
If a model with this special rule is your Army General,
then once per game he may call a Waaagh! The
Waaagh! may only be called if the model first declares
a charge, and must be announced immediately after
making the charge declaration, before any charge
reaction takes place. In the turn a Waaagh! is called,
every combat involving friendly Orc units within 12"
of the Army General adds +1 to its combat resolution
for the rest of the player turn. The Army General
himself, and any unit he joins, adds +D3 to their
combat resolution instead. In addition, every friendly
unit within 12" of the Army General add their rank
bonus to the result rolled on the Animosity table (to a
maximum of 6).

armySpecialRules.name: Wall-Crawler
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule have the Forest Strider and
Obstacle Strider special rules. In addition, they treat
ungarrisoned buildings as open terrain for the purposes
of movement. They may not finish their movement
inside or on top of an ungarrisoned building.
WAAAGH! MISCAST
If an Orc or Goblin Wizard rolls a Miscast, they roll on
the following table instead of the normal Miscast Table
used by other wizards:
D6 Result
1-3 FZZZZZZAP! Resolve the effects as if the
Wizard had cast the Gaze of Mork spell and
then deduct D3 dice from the power pool.
4-5 "Yuuurgh!" The Wizard is subject to the
Frenzy and Stupidity special rules for the
rest of the game, although he may never
lose his Frenzy. He may cast no further
spells this turn.
6-7 "I've Forgot!" The Wizard permanently
reduces his Wizard Level by 1 and may not
cast any further spells this phase.
8-9 "Me 'Ead 'Urts!" All Orcs and Goblins
(friend or foe) within 12" that are capable
of channelling power or dispel dice suffer a
Strength 4 hit which Ignores Armour saves.
In addition, D3 dice are lost from the pool.
10-11 "I Fink I'm Gonna…": The Wizard
suffers a Strength 10 hit and all Orc and
Goblin units (friend or foe) within 12"
suffer D6 Strength 5 hits which Ignores
Armour saves. In addition, D3 dice are lost
from the pool.
12+ 'EADBANG! Place the large round
template over the Wizard. Any model under
the template must pass a Toughness test or
also be killed outright with no armour saves
allowed. After resolving hits from this
template, removing the Wizard as casualty
with no saves allowed. In addition, D3 dice
are lost from the power pool.

magicItems.name: Warboss Ironclaw'S Waaagh! Cleava
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs only. All hits from Warboss Ironclaw's
Waaagh! Cleava Wound automatically with the Ignores
Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Bashas Axe Of Stunty Smashin'
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this weapon has the Armour Piercing
(1) special rule, and adds +1 to both his Attacks and
Strength in close combat. This bonus is doubled if the
wielder is in base contact with a Dwarf. In addition, the
wielder causes Fear in all Dwarfs.

magicItems.name: Basha'S Bloodaxe
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs on foot only. The wielder of Basha's
Bloodaxe gains the Frenzy rule. However, they get
+D6 Attacks (rolled before making their Attacks) rather
than +1 and can never lose their Frenzy.

magicItems.name: Bonehead'S Whacker
magicItems.description:
Savage Orcs only. Great weapon. The Whacker gives
the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule and
allows them to re-roll failed To Wound rolls.

magicItems.name: Shaga'S Screaming Sword
magicItems.description:
Shaga's Screaming Sword gives the wielder the Fear
special rule. In addition, they also gain +1 Strength and
+1 Attack for each enemy character model within 12".

magicItems.name: Basha'S Big Axe Of Bashin'
magicItems.description:
Basha's Big Axe of Bashin' gives wielder +1 Strength
and Attacks.

magicItems.name: Da Choppiest Choppa
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. This weapon gives the wielder +1 Strength
and the Armour Piercing (3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Kleeva'S Cleaver Of Cleavage
magicItems.description:
All hits with Kleeva's Cleaver of Cleavage Wound
automatically. Armour saves are modified by the
Strength of the bearer.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Orcs &
ms found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Martog'S Best Basha
magicItems.description:
Martog's Best Basha gives the wielder +1 Weapon
Skill, +1 Strength and +1 Initiative.

magicItems.name: The Red Fang
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs only. The Red Fang gives the wielder
+1 Attack and +1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: Sneaky Skewerer
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. The Sneaky Skewerer gives the wielder
+1 To Hit and the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Dufffa'S Club Of Duffin'
magicItems.description:
Duffa's Club of Duffin' gives the wielder +3 Attacks in
the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Fumpa'S Club Of Fumpin'
magicItems.description:
Fumpa's Club of Fumpin' gives the wielder +1 Strength
and the Quell Animosity special rule.

magicItems.name: Hacka'S Sword Of Hackin'
magicItems.description:
Hacka's Sword of Hackin' makes the wielder always hit
any opponent on roll of a 2+.

magicItems.name: The Humie Hewers
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons. Whenever the wielder's To Hit roll
on a D6 is higher than his target's Weapon Skill, the
attack will not only hit regardless of the score normally
needed to hit, but will also be multiplied into 2 Hits.

magicItems.name: Krumpa'S Club Of Crumpin'
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. Krumpa's Club of Crumpin' gives the
wielder the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.

magicItems.name: Porko'S Pigstikka
magicItems.description:
Mounted Orcs only. Light lance. On any turn that they
charge, Porko's Pigstikka gives the wielder +1 Attack
for each rank that the unit they are attacking has.

magicItems.name: Ulag'S Ak'Rit Axe
magicItems.description:
Ulag's Ak'rit Axe allows the wielder to re-roll any
failed To Hit rolls.

magicItems.name: Bigger, Choppier Axe
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. Great weapon. This weapon gives the
wielder the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Kurbog'S Curmudgeonly Clobbera
magicItems.description:
Any model Wounded (but not slain) by Kurbog's
Curmudgeonly Clobbera may not attack this close
combat phase. If they have already attacked this close
combat phase, they may not attack in the next close
combat phase.

magicItems.name: Smasha And Kunnin'
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. Two hand weapons. When targeting a
Wizard in close combat, the wielder may re-roll failed
rolls To Hit and gains the Multiple Wounds (D3)
special rule. When targeting a Character that is not a
Wizard in close combat, the wielder may re-roll failed
rolls To Wound and gains the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Backstabber'S Blade
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. The Backstabber's Blade gives the
wielder the Poisoned Attacks special rule. In addition,
they get +1 Strength if they attack the enemy to their
flank, or +2 Strength if they attack the enemy in their
rear.

magicItems.name: Weepwood Big Shiv
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc only. Additional hand weapon. The
Strength of this weapon is increased by 1 for the
remainder of the game for each unsaved Wound it
inflicts on a Monstrous Creature or Monster. Roll to
Wound individually against these Troop Types.

magicItems.name: The Black Fang
magicItems.description:
If the bearer rolls a natural 6 To Hit, that Attack
automatically Wounds with the Multiple Wounds (D3)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Club Wiv A Nail In'
magicItems.description:
Great weapon. The wielder gains the Random Attacks
(D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Greatdrake Toof
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc only. If the bearer rolls a natural 6 To
Wound, that Attack has the Multiple Wounds (D6)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Lucky'S Dirk
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. Lucky's Dirk gives the wielder +1
Strength for each enemy Magic Item in base contact.

magicItems.name: Metalrippa'S Klaw
magicItems.description:
Additional hand weapon. The wielder gains the Armour
Piercing (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Moonhoned Shiv
magicItems.description:
Night Goblin only. The wielder gains +1 Attack. In
addition, they gain the Feigned Flight ability from the
Skirmishers special rule. Each time they use this
ability, they gain +1 Attack for the duration of the
battle.

magicItems.name: Stabby'S Rusty Stikka
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. The wielder will automatically Wound on
a To Hit roll of a natural 6.

magicItems.name: Sword Of Bork
magicItems.description:
Any unit joined by the bearer of the Sword of Bork that
fails their Animosity test may roll 2D6 on the
Animosity table and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Wollopa'S One Hit Wunda
magicItems.description:
One use only. Wollopa's One Hit Wunda may be used
at the start of any close combat phase when it is the
wielder's turn to attack. The wielder may replace all
their normal Attacks with a special attack that is
resolved at +3 Strength with the Heroic Killing Blow
special rule.

magicItems.name: Big Spirit Stikk
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc Wizards only. The wielder of this item
gains the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. Against
Monstrous Creatures and Monsters, they gain the
Multiple Wounds (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Owzat'S Club Of Smackin'
magicItems.description:
An Infantry Character model which suffers an unsaved
Wound (but is not slain) by Owzat's Club of Smackin'
is immediately knocked clean out of combat and
suffers a Strength 4 Hit. Move the model D6"
backwards (measure from the back of any unit it is in),
stopping at least 1" away from other units or
impassable terrain.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Gork
magicItems.description:
Medium Armour. The wearer has +D3 Toughness. Roll
to determine the armour's effectiveness the first time
the wearer is hit each turn, and use the result for the
rest of the turn. In addition, the wearer has the Impact
Hits (D6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Bulak'S Bloody Armour
magicItems.description:
Black Orcs only. Heavy armour. This armour gives the
wearer the Magical Ward (4+) special rule. However, if
they roll a 1 for their Ward save, the number of Wounds
suffered is doubled.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Mork
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. The Armour of Mork gives the wearer
and any unit they join the Magic Resistance (2) special
rule.

magicItems.name: Armour Of Protectyness
magicItems.description:
Medium armour. The Armour of Protectyness gives the
wearer the Regeneration (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Ironskin Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. The Ironskin Shield gives the bearer the
Magical Ward (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Trollhide Trousers
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs or Common Goblins only. This armour
gives the wearer the Natural Armour (6+) and
Regeneration (5+) special rules.
magicItems.restriction: Common Orcs or Common Goblins only.

magicItems.name: Ugbrag'S Lucky Shield
magicItems.description:
Shield. Ugbrag's Lucky Shield enables the wearer to
ignore the first Wounding Hit (after saves) suffered in
the game.

magicItems.name: Nobbla'S 'Elmet
magicItems.description:
Common Goblins only. Nobbla's Helmet gives the
wearer a 6+ armour save and the Magical Ward (6+)
special rule.

magicItems.name: The Spiky Shoulder Plates
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs on foot only. The bearer gains a 6+
armour save and the Impact Hits (1) special rule.

magicItems.name: Spiteful Shield
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. Shield. For each To Hit roll of a 1 against
the bearer in close combat, the Spiteful Shield inflicts a
Strength 5 Hit against the model that struck the blow.

magicItems.name: Headdress Of Many Eyes
magicItems.description:
Forest Goblin on foot only. The wearer can only be hit
in close combat on To Hit rolls of a natural 6.

magicItems.name: Amulet Of Protectyness
magicItems.description:
Whenever the bearer of the Amulet of Protectyness
suffers a Wound, they count as having the same armour
and Ward save as the model that caused the Wound.

magicItems.name: The Clammy Cowl
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. All Close Combat attacks targeting
the wearer of this item must re-roll successful rolls To
Hit.

magicItems.name: Lucky Shrunken Head
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc Wizards only. Any unit joined by the bearer
of the Lucky Shrunken head may re-roll 1's when
taking Magical Ward saves.

magicItems.name: Moonstone Medallion
magicItems.description:
Night Goblin only. This item gives the bearer the
Magical Ward (6+) special rule and may re-roll failed
Magical Ward saves.

magicItems.name: Sizzla'S Shiny Baubles
magicItems.description:
Sizzla's Shiny Baubles can be used against any
successfully cast enemy spell that targets the bearer or
the unit they are with. Roll a D6; on 1-3 nothing
happens; on a 4+ the spell is reflected back at the caster
and their unit and affects them instead, following all
the normal rules for the spell. The original caster may
then attempt to dispel their own spell using any
remaining power dice.

magicItems.name: The Collar Of Zorga
magicItems.description:
War Beasts, Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Creatures,
Monsters and all mounts require 6's to hit the bearer. In
addition, the wearer can attempt to take control of any
creatures in base contact mentioned above at the start
of each round of Close Combat. Each player rolls a D6
for each beast and add the unmodified Leadership of
the wearer of the Collar and each beast he is trying to
control. If the Orc player scores equal or higher, he
takes control of that beast who will now attack any
friendly models in base contact for the remainder of the
close combat phase (including Stomps, but not Impact
Hits). If there are no friendly models for the beast to
attack, it simply makes no attacks this round. If the Orc
player scores lower, the beast may act normally this
turn.

magicItems.name: Effigy Of Mork
magicItems.description:
Savage Orcs only. All close combat attacks made
against the bearer of the Effigy of Mork suffer -1 To
Hit.

magicItems.name: Mork'S Eye Pebble
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. One use only. This item may be used at
the start of any enemy shooting phase. If they do so,
the bearer and all friendly units within 12" gain the
Magical Ward (5+) special rule against missile attacks
for the duration of this phase.

magicItems.name: Warboss Umm'S Best Big Boss'S 'At
magicItems.description:
Warboss Umm's Best Big Boss's 'At gives the wearer
the Magical Ward (4+) special rule. However, if the
wearer fails its Magical Ward save at any point, it will
no longer have any effect from the start of the next
player turn.

magicItems.name: Daubing Of Mork
magicItems.description:
Orcs on foot only. Enemy models must re-roll 6's To
Wound against the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: Necklace Of Blessed Teef
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Necklace of Blessed Teef may re-roll
any armour or Ward Save rolls of 1.

magicItems.name: Sparkly Wizard Finda
magicItems.description:
The bearer of the Sparkly Wizard Finda has the Hatred
(Wizards) and Magic Resistance (3) special rules.

magicItems.name: Dokk Juice
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc Wizards only. One use only. This item may
be used at the start of any turn. Once used, the imbiber
gains the Regeneration (4+) special rule for the
remainder of the turn.

magicItems.name: Glowin' Tattooz
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc only. The bearer of this item may re-roll
failed Magical Ward save rolls.

magicItems.name: Glowy Green Amulet
magicItems.description:
Instead of making a normal dispel attempt, the wearer
of the Glowy Green Amulet may attempt to nullify any
enemy spell cast at the bearer or the unit they are with
by a rolling a number of dice equal to the number of
dice used to cast the spell. As long as no 1's are rolled,
the spell is dispelled. However, if two or more 1's are
rolled, the spell gets through automatically and the
wearer is killed outright (with no saves allowed).

magicItems.name: Glowy Howzit
magicItems.description:
This item gives the bearer the Magical Ward (5+)
special rule. At the end of each phase in which the
model suffered 1 or more Wounds, roll a D6 for each
failed Ward save roll they made. On the roll a 1, the
Glowy Howzit cannot be used for the remainder of the
game.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Sneaky Stealin'
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. Staff. At the start of each of your Magic
phases, the Staff of Sneaky Stealin' allows you to
remove one dice from the opponent's Dispel dice pool
and add it to your own Power dice pool.

magicItems.name: Skull Wand Of Kaloth
magicItems.description:
Staff. The Skull Wand unleashes a curse on a single
enemy model that is in base contact with the bearer at
the start of the Close Combat phase. The victim must
pass a Leadership test (using its own, unmodified,
Leadership) or be slain instantly, with no save of any
kind allowed. In addition, the bearer of the Skull Wand
causes Terror.

magicItems.name: Great Green Visions
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. Relic. The bearer of this item may re-roll
failed channelling rolls.

magicItems.name: Speaky-Skull Fetish
magicItems.description:
Relic. Every time the bearer of this item rolls a 6 on
their channelling roll, they gain an extra dice to the
pool.

magicItems.name: Beast-Lure Glyphs
magicItems.description:
Savage Orcs only. Charm. One use only. The caster
may cast one of their spells (with a casting value of 10
maximum) without using any power dice. The spell
counts as having been cast on their minimum casting
value and may be dispelled as normal.

magicItems.name: Idol Of Mork
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. Relic. At the start of your magic phase, the
Idol of Mork adds one power dice to your power pool
for every friendly Orc unit (any type) with 10 or more
Unit Strength in combat within 24" if the bearer.
However, it removes one power dice from your power
pool for every friendly fleeing Orc (any type) with 10
or more Unit Strength unit within 24" of the bearer.

magicItems.name: Scuttlepot
magicItems.description:
Forest Goblins only. Relic. The bearer of this item
gains a +D3 casting bonus. Roll for each casting
attempt.

magicItems.name: Ditto'S Double Doin' Doodahs
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of Ditto's Double Doin' Doodahs may
choose to attempt to cast one of their spells twice per
Magic phase.

magicItems.name: Loonstone Talisman
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. Night Goblin Wizard only. This
item may be used at the start of any enemy Magic
phase. Each time a Wizard with this item dispels an
enemy spell this turn, they gain +1 Power Dice that
they can use in their next Magic phase (up to a
maximum of +3 dice).

magicItems.name: Buzgob'S Knobbly Staff
magicItems.description:
Staff. Buzgob's Knobbly Staff allows the wielder to re-
roll all power dice used to cast a spell once per Magic
phase (before rolling any Ultimate Power dice). This
cannot be used if a miscast is rolled.

magicItems.name: Mork'S Boney Bitz
magicItems.description:
Savage Orcs only. Relic. The bearer of this item gains
+1 to cast for every Monster within 18".

magicItems.name: Shamanic Skullcape
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs only. Relic. The bearer of this item
gains a +1 casting bonus. In addition, if they
successfully kill an enemy Wizard in close combat or
with a spell, you may choose one of the spells they
knew at that time. The model may then cast that spell
themselves for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Staff Of Baduum
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of this item gains a +2 casting bonus
to one of their spells, chosen at the start of the battle.
However, in case a Miscast is rolled when casting that
spell, add 1 to the result rolled on the Waaagh! Miscast
chart.
WAAAGH! PAINT* 15 points
Savage Orcs only. Relic. If the wearer of the Waaagh!
Paint is in close combat at the start of your Magic
phase, they gain a +2 to casting bonus.
magicItems.restriction:
Staff. The bearer of this item gains a +2 casting bonus
to one of their spells, chosen at the start of the battle.
However, in case a Miscast is rolled when casting that
spell, add 1 to the result rolled on the Waaagh! Miscast
chart.
WAAAGH! PAINT* 15 points
Savage Orcs only.

magicItems.name: Amberbone Hoard
magicItems.description:
Orc Wizard only. Relic. The bearer of this item gains
+1 Strength and +1 Attack.

magicItems.name: Da Hag'S Brew
magicItems.description:
Relic. In addition to the Lores of Magic they may
normally know spells from, the bearer of Da Hag's
Brew knows the Signature spell from the Lore of Troll
Magic.

magicItems.name: Dangly Wotnotz
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. When casting a spell, the bearer
of the Dangly Wotnotz may use it to add +1 to the
result of one of the dice rolled. This may cause
Ultimate Power or prevent a Miscast.

magicItems.name: Da Great Zappa Squig
magicItems.description:
Savage Orcs only. Charm. One use only. This item can
be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. Roll a
D6 and consult the table below:
D6 Result:
1 The bearer suffers a Strength 5 Hit.
2-4 The bearer gains +1 Power dice.
5-6 The bearer gains +D3 Power dice.

magicItems.name: The Crown Of Gork
magicItems.description:
Common Orc only. All friendly units within 12" of the
bearer may re-roll failed Animosity tests.

magicItems.name: Squigriler Pipes
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. This item may be used in your
Remaining Moves sub-phase. When used, all Squig
units within 18" will immediately make a Random
Move (using their normal Random Movement) directly
towards the bearer of this item. If they get into base
contact with the bearer, it is immediately removed as a
casualty.

magicItems.name: Bigged'S 'Ed Kickin' Boots
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs and Black Orcs on foot only. The
wearer of Bigged's 'Ed Kickin' Boots gains the Stomp
(D3) special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Common Orcs and Black Orcs on foot only.

magicItems.name: Ironback Boar
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs and Black Orcs only. War Boar. The
Ironback Boar has Strength 4 and the Impact Hits (D3)
special rule.
magicItems.restriction: Common Orcs and Black Orcs only.

magicItems.name: Moonface Mommet
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. One use only. This item can be
used against an enemy character (even within a unit)
within 12" and Line of Sight during your Shooting
phase. The target must take a Panic test. If passed, the
model may not voluntarily move in their next turn.

magicItems.name: The Pipes Of Doom
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. One use only. The Pipes of Doom
can be used at the start of the Shooting Phase. All
enemy War Beasts (including Mixed Units), Cavalry,
Monstrous Beasts, Monstrous Cavalry, Chariots
(except those that do not have any mounts pulling
them) and Monsters within 12" must take a Panic test.

magicItems.name: Tricksy Trinket
magicItems.description:
Goblins (of any type) only. No units in base contact
with the wearer of the Tricksy Trinket may take
Magical Ward saves.
DA THINKIN' ORC'S 'AT 25 Points
Common Orc only. The wearer of Da Thinkin' Orc's 'At
gains +1 Initiative. In addition, the wearer and any unit
they have joined is not subject to the Animosity special
rule.

magicItems.name: Glareface'S Grin
magicItems.description:
Common Goblins only. One use only. This item may be
used the start of any of your shooting phases. Pick a
point on the battlefield within 6" of the bearer. All
enemy units within 12" and with Line of Sight to that
point suffers D6 Strength 5 Hits.

magicItems.name: The Horn Of Urgok
magicItems.description:
One use only. The horn can be used at the start of any
of your turns. When this horn is sounded, all friendly
units within 24" receive +1 Leadership and all enemy
units within 24" suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership
until the end of the turn.

magicItems.name: Savage Trophy
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc only. Army General only. The bearer of this
item and any friendly units of Savage Orcs within 12"
gain +1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: El Grobis' Mask Of The Fearsome Renown
magicItems.description:
Goblin Bosses only. The bearer gains the Fear and
Hidden special rules. In addition, it gains the Always
Strikes First and Armour Piercing (1) special rules on
the turn that it is revealed or charges into an enemy
unit's flank or rear.

magicItems.name: Grisly Trophy Rack
magicItems.description:
Warboss or Big Boss only. All enemy units within 6" of
the bearer of the Grisly Trophy Rack suffer -1 modifier
to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Mad Cap Mushrooms
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. One use only. If the model bearing
the Mad Cap Mushrooms is in a unit containing one or
more Night Goblin Fanatics, each Fanatic from this
unit inflicts an additional D6 Hits on any unit they
move into base contact with this turn.

magicItems.name: Nibbla'S 'Itty Ring
magicItems.description:
Bound Spell, Power Level 4. Nibbla's 'Itty Ring
contains the Vindictive Glare spell from the Lore of the
Little Waaagh! Roll a D6 each time it has successfully
been cast; on the roll of a 1, the caster suffers a
Strength 5 Hit.

magicItems.name: Spiker Seeds
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. One use only. This item can be used if
the bearer is charged and chooses to Hold or Stand &
Shoot. All models in the enemy unit must take a
Dangerous Terrain test before they begin their charge
move (at the same time as any Stand & Shoot reaction
is resolved).

magicItems.name: Warboss Imbad'S Iron Gnashas
magicItems.description:
Common Orcs and Black Orcs only. The model
wearing Imbad's Iron Gnashas gains +1 Attack with the
Killing Blow special rule. This attack does not benefit
from any other weapon rules the wearer might have.
magicItems.restriction: Common Orcs and Black Orcs only.

magicItems.name: Beastkilla Slop
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any close combat phase. One enemy
monster in base contact with the bearer of this item
must take a number of Toughness tests equal to their
starting number of Wounds. Each failed Toughness test
causes D3 Wounds with no saves allowed. This has no
effect against Daemons or Animated Constructs.

magicItems.name: Brimstone Bauble
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. If the bearer of the Brimstone Bauble is
slain in close combat (not including pursuit), all units
(friends and foe) in base contact suffer D6 Strength 6
Hits, distributed as Hits from shooting. Any Wounds
caused count towards combat resolution.

magicItems.name: Eye-Biter Ash
magicItems.description:
Goblins only. One use only. This item can be used at
the start of any close combat phase. When used, roll a
D6 and consult the table below:
D6 Result:
1 The bearer and their unit suffer -1 To Hit in
close combat this phase.
2 No effect
3-6 All enemy units in base contact with the
bearer suffer -1 To Hit in close combat this
phase.

magicItems.name: Guzzla'S Battle Brew
magicItems.description:
Roll a D6 for the bearer of Guzzla's Battle Brew at the
start of the game and consult the table below to see
what effect it has:
D6 Result:
1 The model gains the Stupidity special rule.
2-4 The model gains the Hatred special rule.
5-6 The model gains the Hatred and Frenzy
special rule.

magicItems.name: The Golden Toof
magicItems.description:
Orcs only. The bearer of this item and any unit that
they join may roll an additional dice and discard the
highest result when taking Break tests. This has no
effect if the bearer is a Lone Character.

magicItems.name: Maad'S Map
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Before deployment, roll a D6. On
4+, the bearer of Maad's Map and one unit they must
join gains the Scouts special rule. On a 1-3, the unit has
gotten lost and gains the Ambushers special rule
instead.

magicItems.name: Rotting Dankhold Spores
magicItems.description:
Dankhold Trollboss only. One use only. This item may
be used at the start of any round of Close Combat. All
enemy units must pass D6 Toughness tests or suffer a
Wound which Ignores Armour Saves for each failed
test.
'EADBUTTIN' 'AT 10 points
Orcs only. The 'Eadbuttin' 'At gives the wearer a
special attack in challenges. This attack causes a hit at
the wearer Strength with the Multiple Wounds (D3)
special rule. This attack does not benefit from any other
weapon rules the wearer might have.

magicItems.name: Loonstone Teefcaps
magicItems.description:
Mounted Night Goblins only. The close combat attacks
of the bearer's mount have the Armour Piercing (2)
special rule.

magicItems.name: Pet Gribbly
magicItems.description:
Dankhold Trollboss only. Every time the bearer of this
item suffers an unsaved Wound, roll a D6. On a 1, the
Pet Gribbly is squished and removed from the game.
When the Pet Gribbly is squished, the bearer gains the
Hatred and Frenzy special rule for the remainder of the
game.

magicItems.name: Lucky Bone
magicItems.description:
Savage Orc only. The bearer of this item may re-roll a
single To Hit or To Wound roll of 1 each close combat
phase.

magicItems.name: Crunchy Shinies
magicItems.description:
Dankhold Trollboss only. One use only. This item may
be used at the start of any of your Movement phases.
For the duration of this turn, the bearer gains +2
Movement and +2 Initiative.

magicItems.name: Fungus Wine
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. One use only. This item may be
used at the start of any of your turns. Until the start of
your next turns, the model and any unit they are with
have the Immunity (Psychology) special rule.

magicItems.name: Web-Strung Cloak
magicItems.description:
Forest Goblins only. Enemy units in base contact with
the bearer of this item roll one dice less for their flee
moves.

magicItems.name: Mork'S Spirit Totem
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Magic
Resistance (D6) special rule. Roll to determine the
effectiveness of the banner every time a spell is cast on
the unit carrying it. For example, if a 5 is rolled, the
unit with have Magic Resistance (5) against that spell.
In addition, all magic items belonging to enemy units
that are in base contact with the bearer of Mork's Spirit
Totem do not work and will count as mundane versions
of the same type.

magicItems.name: The Bad Moon Banner
magicItems.description:
Night Goblins only. The model carrying this standard
and any unit they join gains the Stubborn special rule,
and enemies suffer -1 To Hit with missile weapons
against them. In addition, any enemy model that
charges into base contact with the bearer or their unit
must take a Dangerous Terrain test.

magicItems.name: Rowdy Grott'S Big Red Raggedy Banner
magicItems.description:
Common Goblins only. All Goblins within 12" of this
standard have the Cold-blooded special rule.

magicItems.name: Da Angry Ladz Flag
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy
special rule.
GORK'S WAAAGH! BANNER 25 points
Orcs only. The unit carrying this standard gains D6" to
its charge distance. This does not affect the unit's
maximum charge range for the purpose of determining
mandatory charge declarations. If the charge is failed,
the unit will move forward its normal failed charge
distance.
magicItems.restriction:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Frenzy
special rule.
GORK'S WAAAGH! BANNER 25 points
Orcs only.

magicItems.name: Spider Banner
magicItems.description:
Forest Goblins only. The unit carrying this standard
gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Totem Of The Spider God
magicItems.description:
Forest Goblins only. The unit carrying this standard
gains the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule (including
mounts).

magicItems.name: The Evil Sun Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may re-roll any failed
Animosity tests.

magicItems.name: Da Banner Of Da Nomadz
magicItems.description:
Goblin Wolf Riders or Snarlfang Riders only. The unit
carrying this standard may re-roll 1's for their charge,
flee or pursuit rolls.
magicItems.restriction: Goblin Wolf Riders or Snarlfang Riders only.

magicItems.name: The Bashin' Flag Of Bork
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard ignores their first failed
Animosity roll of the game - it passes the test instead.

magicItems.name: Guff'S Windy Banner
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed Panic
tests.

magicItems.name: Nogg'S Banner Of Butchery
magicItems.description:
One use only. This standard may be used at the start of
any close combat phase. All models in the unit (except
mounts) gain +1 Attack for the remainder of the close
combat phase.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Wildz
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard may re-roll failed
Dangerous Terrain tests.
